title: Investigating grammatical abstraction in language models using few-shot learning of novel noun gender

bias_targets.methodology: The authors evaluate LSTMs and Transformer models on their ability to learn and generalize the grammatical gender of novel French nouns using few-shot learning. Bias is measured by comparing the models' prediction accuracy on grammatical agreement tasks (e.g., noun-adjective, noun-participle) for feminine versus masculine nouns, revealing a default bias toward the masculine gender category.
